main_topics.reason: The user described being unable to function for days after walking or yoga and asked how to avoid another crash.
The conversation focused on finding a tolerable starting level, building activity slowly, and limiting activity on good days.
The user asked whether walking or yoga was better and responded positively to the suggestion of warm-water exercise.
The user asked how long it might take to notice a difference and discussed their past pattern of overdoing activity or giving up.
The user said they felt stuck and punished by post-exercise crashes, and noted that pacing would require a mindset shift.

output.summary: The user with fibromyalgia described delayed crashes after walking or beginner yoga despite common advice to exercise, and asked how to move without triggering another flare. The assistant suggested starting with very small amounts, pacing good days, considering warm-water exercise, and tracking gradual progress; the user said the advice was genuinely useful and left with a plan to try the pool cautiously.
